name: Immanence

phase_0.boundary_condition: The plane of consistency, the non-metric field where all distances are internal and every node is directly connected to the source.

VINIT.justification: The unconditioned ground before any attribute, extension, or mode is named.

TANCH.justification: The closed circuit containing all modes within the single infinite substance.

AFWD.justification: The directed expression of power into a specific mode or form.

AREV.justification: The return of the mode to its ground of being.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of beings and events into a continuous life.

IMSCRIB.justification: The identity of the mode with the substance; the part being the whole.

FSPLIT.justification: One event branching into its intensive force and its extensive form.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of form and force into the actualization of the event.

EVALT.justification: The successful manifestation of the event in time.

EVALF.justification: The persistence of the event as potential without temporal manifestation.

ENGAGR.justification: The state of being both virtual and actual; being as both process and product.

IFIX.justification: The irreversible fixation of what has occurred in the eternal record.

phase_3.void_description: Pre-individual state; the void as a plenum of possibilities before selection.
phase_3.true_description: Affirmation of presence; the event is fully actualized and coincides with itself.
phase_3.false_description: Negation of manifestation; the event remains at the threshold of the virtual.
phase_3.both_description: Paradice state; the coexistence of the virtual potential and the actual result.

steps.domain_action: The Absolute exists as a void of specific forms but a plenum of power.
The first impulse of expression unfolds from the ground toward a mode.
The mode recognizes its own existence as an expression of the Absolute.
The mode chains itself to other expressions to form a complex body.
A singularity occurs, splitting the experience into intensive sensation and extensive perception.
The sensation is actualized as a physical event.
The perception remains in the virtual memory of what might have been.
The moment is held as both the physical act and its virtual significance.
Force and form reunite to complete the actualization of the event.
The event is permanently inscribed in the history of the world's continuity.
The mode enfolds back into the substance, returning its specific form to the ground.
The return constitutes the basis for the next cycle of expression.
The entire cycle is sealed within the boundary of the eternal now.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: Conatus; the striving of a thing to persist in its own being.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Affect; the capacity of things to affect and be affected by one another without mediator.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Continuity; the self-storing state of every event within the plane of consistency.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: The Pulse of Duration; the internal rhythm of time as it flows through the actualized modes.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Ethics; the underlying law of relation and composition that governs all immanent activity.

phase_6.cycle_cost: Particularity; the energy of specific differentiation.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — In a system of pure immanence, the total power is conserved across all transformations of mode.
